notes:
VoxSwell 1.1.0
- Reverb controls: Decay (with Auto), Gap, Tone and Low Cut
- Four swell curves: Soft, Classic, Late Bloom, S-Curve
- Stereo swell from mono vocals, with a Width control
- 18 tempo-synced lengths, including 1/8, dotted and triplet
- Factory and user presets with A/B compare
- Bar-aligned export and BWF timestamp so the swell lands right before the vocal
- Swell + word output and 32-bit float export
- Projects made with 1.0 sound exactly the same
